arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
repo=/srv/lowcost-europa
echo "STATIC_AUDIT_BEGIN"
echo "ENVIRONMENTFILES"
systemctl show lowcost-europa.service -p EnvironmentFiles -p WorkingDirectory -p User --no-pager
echo "CRITICAL_SOURCE_NAMES"
find "$repo/apps" -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*views.py' -o -name '*eligibility.py' -o -name '*weekly_discovery.py' -o -name '*maintenance.py' \) | sed "s#$repo/##" | head -35
echo "PUBLIC_ELIGIBILITY_CODE"
sed -n '1,180p' "$repo/apps/catalog/services/public_eligibility.py"
echo "WEEKLY_DISCOVERY_RULES"
grep -nE -C 2 'PENDING_CAP_PER_FAMILY|pending_before|20|allow|candidate|cap' "$repo/apps/catalog/services/weekly_discovery.py" | head -85
echo "SECURITY_SETTINGS"
grep -nE 'SECURE_|SESSION_COOKIE|CSRF_COOKIE|DEBUG|ALLOWED_HOSTS|X_FRAME|CONTENT_SECURITY' "$repo/config/settings/production.py" | head -65
echo "STATIC_AUDIT_END"

set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "LIVE_HTTP_BEGIN"
base=https://lowcost-europa.duckdns.org
for path in / /robots.txt /health/live/ /health/ready/ /painel/ /admin/; do 
  printf 'PATH=%s ' "$path"
  curl -sS --max-time 15 -o /dev/null -w 'CODE=%{http_code} TLS=%{ssl_verify_result} TIME=%{time_total}\n' "$base$path"
done
echo "ROOT_HEADERS"
curl -sSI --max-time 15 "$base/" | grep -iE '^(HTTP/|strict-transport-security:|content-security-policy:|x-frame-options:|x-content-type-options:|referrer-policy:|x-robots-tag:|location:)' || :
echo "HTTP_REDIRECT"
curl -sSI --max-time 15 "http://lowcost-europa.duckdns.org/" | grep -iE '^(HTTP/|location:)' || :
echo "SERVICES_LAST_RUNS"
for svc in lowcost-europa-weekly-discovery.service lowcost-europa-catalog-maintenance.service lowcost-europa-backup.service lowcost-europa-offsite-backup.service lowcost-europa-offsite-backup-health.service;do printf '%s ' "$svc";systemctl show "$svc" -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --no-pager | tr '\n' ' ';echo;done
echo "LIVE_HTTP_END"
